#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cctype>

struct FastInput {
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 16;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int bufferPointer, bytesRead;

    FastInput() : bufferPointer(0), bytesRead(0) {}

    char read() {
        if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
            bytesRead = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, stdin);
            bufferPointer = 0;
            if (bytesRead == 0) {
                return EOF;
            }
        }
        return buffer[bufferPointer++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        char c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') {
            c = read();
        }
        bool neg = (c == '-');
        if (neg) {
            c = read();
        }
        do {
            ret = ret * 10 + c - '0';
        } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
        return neg ? -ret : ret;
    }
};

bool get(int w, int m) {
    if (m == 0) return true;
    if (m % w != 0) return false;
    m = m / w;
    if (m == 1) return true;
    return get(w, m) || get(w, m - 1) || get(w, m + 1);
}

int main() {
    FastInput in;
    int w = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    bool ans = get(w, m) || get(w, m - 1) || get(w, m + 1);
    if (ans) {
        std::cout << "YES\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "NO\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
